keys=['board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete','reward']
print("after13:",{k:res.get(k) for k in keys})
if not (res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('game_over') or res.get('run_complete')):
    res2=action(['LEFT'])
    print("after14:",{k:res2.get(k) for k in keys})
# report final square positions
def sqpos(f):
    A=f.ascii.split('\n');rs=[];cs=[]
    for i in range(64):
        for j in range(64):
            if A[i][j]=='S': rs.append(i);cs.append(j)
    left=[(i,j) for i,j in zip(rs,cs) if j<32];right=[(i,j) for i,j in zip(rs,cs) if j>=32]
    def bb(p):
        rr=[x[0] for x in p];cc=[x[1] for x in p];return (min(rr),min(cc))
    return [bb(left),bb(right)]
print("final squares:",sqpos(current_frame))
